title: Eric Weinstein joins Galileo Project, geometric unity UAP physics
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Eric Weinstein joins Galileo Project, geometric unity UAP physics, about 2021-2022 at Galileo Project, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: My colleague Eric Weinstein recently joined the Galileo project. We sometimes speculate about the physics of UAPs.

plain: In a 2022 conversation, a Harvard researcher, Avi Loeb, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that his colleague, the researcher Eric Weinstein, had recently joined the Galileo Project, a Harvard effort to look for evidence of alien technology. Loeb says the two sometimes speculate about the physics of UAP, the official term for unidentified flying objects. It matters because it shows serious scientists trying to work out how such objects could move.
